notes: Identity independently checked: canonical text is a full Springer primary research article, A bimodal extension of the Eriksen flanker task, by Rolf Ulrich, Laura Prislan, and Jeff Miller; DOI 10.3758/s13414-020-02150-8. Online publication 11 November 2020 and volume 83, pages 790–799 (2021) agree with the supplied reference. Includes Methods, Results, Discussion, references and article metadata; not an abstract-only excerpt or preregistration. No PDF supplied, so PDF page 6 cannot be visually verified; section and figure locators are used. Only assigned unfinished fields evaluated; all other fields are placeholders. The printed effect label is η²; no partial/generalized standardisation is inferred. The mean RT test matches the three-condition outcome.
